Tour de Coler

Bentonville, AR · Coler Mountain Bike Preserve · Mountain bike

No-dropBeginner friendly

Tour de Coler is a mountain bike group ride in Bentonville, AR. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from The Grove parking lot, Coler Mountain Bike Preserve. Pace: groups split by ability and riding style.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: groups split by ability and riding style. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tour de Coler group ride

A free weekly mountain bike group ride at Coler, run by the foundation that manages the preserve. All skill levels, meeting at The Grove parking lot. Check the Coler events page for the time.
